summary: The file books/std/util/definductive.lisp (258KB, 6116 lines) is the complete implementation of the definductive macro for ACL2. It defines inductive predicates via inference rules and generates: fixtypes of proofs, proof validity predicates, main predicates via proof existence, minimality predicates, descent functions, induction schemes, constrained alternative functions, and extensive theorems connecting all components. It also generates comprehensive XDOC documentation. This is substantial formal mathematical content — a foundational macro system for inductive definitions with full proof infrastructure.

summary: All four files contain substantial formal mathematical content and should remain in the primary search index. definductive.lisp is the complete implementation of the definductive macro for inductive definitions with full proof infrastructure (fixtypes, validity predicates, induction schemes, theorems, XDOC). definductive-tests.lisp contains comprehensive formal tests exercising all features of definductive via ACL2 events (must-succeed*, must-be-redundant, assert-event). defret-mutual-generate.lisp implements a theorem generation system using rules on function signatures with mutual induction support. defretgen.lisp extends this to user-specified function sets with dependency ordering.
